evidence: holdsGoFile now lists the directory with os.ReadDir, so a path containing [, *, ? or a backslash is no longer interpreted as a glob pattern.
The loop skips directory entries, so a subdirectory named x.go no longer counts as a Go file. The old Glob would have matched it, so this tightens the check rather than regressing it.
A symlink to a directory reports IsDir() false and a symlink named *.go counts as a file. Glob treated both the same way, so there is no behavior change.
The test adds a package named a[1] and expects it to be passed to staticcheck, which covers the metacharacter case.
I could not see the import block of analyzers.go in the diff, so I assumed os and strings are already imported there. A missing import would be a compile error, which CI would catch.
